verdict.rationale: Bento is a SaaS email platform, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. It documents a first-party hosted MCP server at https://mcp.bentonow.com/mcp that requires no install, and the docs list its capabilities: subscriber lookup, broadcasts and event tracking. A probe confirms the MCP docs page exists, and Skills guidance tells agents when to use MCP. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
